latest_release.body:
## 🚀 Xray-core v26.10.21, Kernel AmneziaWG, Per-Client Hosts & a Rebuilt Telegram Bot

- 🔐 **Security hardening** — Fresh databases get a random first user, generated WireGuard/AmneziaWG configs are checked line by line, and client IPs behind a proxy can no longer be spoofed.
- ⚙️ **Xray-core v26.10.21** — The panel follows the new core's XDRIVE and Lua-script rules and adds the finalmask source-IP filter, Lua noise scripts and XDNS over DoH.
- 🚄 **Kernel AmneziaWG** — An opt-in Linux kernel datapath per inbound, plus much faster uploads on the embedded datapath.
- 🎯 **Smarter hosts** — Bind host rules to individual clients, give a host a pool of SNIs, expand CIDR ranges into random IPs, and order hosts across inbounds.
- 🤖 **Telegram bot rebuilt** — One live screen per chat edited in place, inline search for long lists, and admin notifications routed to a forum topic.
- 🔗 **Cipher suites in share links** — Links carry `cs` and pin the fingerprint so it takes effect, with presets in the editor.
- 📈 **Large-install performance** — Cached subscription bodies, indexed token and Telegram lookups, a pooled gRPC connection and far fewer redundant database writes.
- 🐳 **Docker on ARM and 386** — The `linux/386`, `arm/v6` and `arm/v7` images now ship the right Xray and MTProto binaries.

---

### 🔐 Security
- A new database's first panel user gets a random username and password printed to the server log, not a fixed default pair ([`1df8ab29`](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/commit/1df8ab29))
- WireGuard and AmneziaWG `.conf` files from the subscription service, clients page, inbound modal and subscription page are built line by line and render nothing when a value holds a control character. Imported `vpn://` profiles that carry wg-quick hook directives are refused, and client `allowedIPs` are validated on every save ([`0faad4f4`](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/commit/0faad4f4))
- The client address behind a trusted proxy comes from the proxy end of `X-Forwarded-For`, and a client-supplied `X-Real-IP` is no longer believed. The documented Caddyfile and the docs reverse-proxy generator now overwrite it ([`d50c419e`](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/commit/d50c419e))

### 🆕 New
- AmneziaWG inbounds can run on an opt-in Linux kernel datapath. It runs NAT-only, with host preflight checks, a bundled installer pinned to verified module commits, and accounting that survives restarts. It never goes through awg-quick, and the master refuses to push kernel mode to nodes that predate it ([#6877](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/pull/6877)) @YoungReckless4
- AmneziaWG clients accept a randomised persistent-keepalive range such as `15-25` in `.conf` and `vpn://` profiles ([#6881](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/pull/6881)) @YoungReckless4
- The Telegram bot keeps one live screen per chat and edits it in place. The menu is grouped into Server, Clients, Traffic and Maintenance, long lists open through inline search, QR codes arrive as one sheet, and repeated notices collapse into one ([#6760](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/pull/6760)) @DIMFLIX
- Admin notifications can go to a forum topic with `chatId:topicId` ([#6879](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/pull/6879)) @gr219
- A client can be bound to specific host rules, so its raw, JSON and Clash subscriptions render only those hosts ([#6620](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/pull/6620)) @NethminaYasas
- A host can hold a pool of SNIs, picked at random per config or once per subscription fetch for the whole host group ([#6923](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/pull/6923)) @Pejman-Yousefi-Official
- A host address can be a CIDR range, expanded into up to 100 unique random IPs per subscription fetch and in panel previews and tunnel exports ([#6784](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui/pull/6784)) @Pejman-Yousefi-Official

**3X-UI** is an advanced, open-source web control panel for managing [Xray-core](https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core) servers. It provides a clean, multi-language interface for deploying, configuring, and monitoring a wide range of proxy and VPN protocols — from a single VPS to multi-node deployments. Built as an enhanced fork of the original X-UI project, 3X-UI adds broader protocol support, improved stability, per-client traffic accounting, and many quality-of-life features. > [!IMPORTANT] > This project is intended for personal use only. Please do not use it for illegal purposes or in a production environment. ## Features - **Multi-protocol inbounds** — VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, TUIC v5, Hysteria2, MTProto, HTTP, SOCKS (Mixed), Dokodemo-door / Tunnel, and TUN. - **Modern transports & security** — TCP (Raw), mKCP, WebSocket, gRPC, HTTPUpgrade, and XHTTP, secured with TLS, XTLS, and REALITY. - **AmneziaWG built in** — DPI-resistant WireGuard runs inside the panel on a userspace network stack, with no kernel module, DKMS, or extra packages to install. - **Native TUIC v5 server** — In-process Go QUIC server with Xray routing and per-client traffic accounting; BBR and New Reno are available server-side. CUBIC is preserved in the client profile but currently falls back to New Reno on the server. - **MTProto proxies** — per-client FakeTLS secrets, ad-tags, and quotas, applied live without dropping existing connections. - **Fallbacks** — serve multiple protocols on a single port (e.g. VLESS and Trojan on 443) using Xray's f
